heard: Millions of invisible black holes are silently prowling our galaxy. Astronomers detected the first confirmed rogue stellar mass black hole wandering entirely alone. This dark remnant was found via gravitational microlensing in the direction of the galactic bulge. The Hubble Space Telescope measured the tiny astrometric deflection of background starlight over six years. Data from 16 different ground-based telescopes helped confirm the anomaly. The latest analysis determined the mass of the black hole lens to be 7.15 solar masses. Hurled through space at 51.1 kilometers per second by a supernova kick, it emits zero detectable light.
